_comment: Release-evidence freshness floors for security-critical dependencies. Every catalogKey in SECURITY_RELEVANT_CATALOG_KEYS (scripts/check-security-dependency-freshness.py) must appear here, so a security-relevant pin cannot ship without a reviewed floor. Raising a floor is a deliberate review step: update minimumVersion and reviewedOn together.

dependencies.reason: SQLCipher 4.17.0 includes the reviewed SQLite CVE baseline for encrypted personal dictionaries.

Tink wraps the personal dictionary, clipboard and Tasker secrets. CVE-2026-15432 (GHSA-xxmf-j3rw-f8p2, published 2026-07-21) reports a non-constant-time tag comparison in ChunkedMacVerification and lists no patched version. SwiftFloris uses no ChunkedMac API anywhere in app/ or lib/, so the timing side channel is unreachable here; 1.23.0 stays the floor and this entry is the reminder to raise it when a patched release ships.

Room is the storage engine for the SQLCipher-encrypted personal dictionary and clipboard history. No advisories affect 2.x as of this review; Room 2.x is in maintenance mode, so regressions below this pin are treated as unreviewed.
Driver layer beneath Room and SQLCipher. No advisories as of this review; pinned so a downgrade below the reviewed baseline fails the release.

CVE-2026-53914 (GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp) is an unsafe deserialization of build-cache metadata, fixed only in 2.4.20 which is still pre-release (RC, 2026-08-12). The attack requires write access to the build cache; this repository has no CI and no shared remote cache, so 2.4.10 remains the reviewed floor. See scripts/check-kotlin-build-cache-cve-guard.py.
KSP runs in the build and must stay on the Kotlin line pinned above; a mismatched processor is a build-integrity risk rather than a runtime one.
AGP produces the signed APK and enforces the merged-manifest permission allowlist. No advisories affect 9.3.1 as of this review.
